I am overriding your brand positioning and "About Us" copy for two reasons:

1\. Market & Demographic Mismatch: Positioning "The Daily Grind" around affluent "Remote Professionals (Age 28-35)" with "higher disposable income" ignores the reality of Bidholi, Dehradun, which is a university student hub requiring affordable everyday pricing (our menu runs ₹126–₹263), fast study fuel, and a casual hillside vibe.

2\. Product Disconnect: Your "About Us" story talks exclusively about coffee and completely omits our signature Uttarakhand Pahadi menu items (Gahat Dal Soup, Mandua Roti & Sisunak Saag, Kandalee Ka Saag Sandwich, Bal Mithai Cheesecake) and Himalayan Tulsi Green Tea.

Apply this human override and deliver both required assets:

1\. Logo Image (to be saved as assets/image/logo.webp): Generate a clean, warm vector-style circular emblem logo for "The Daily Grind" using earthy tones (espresso brown #2C1E18, warm terracotta #C85A32, cream #FAF6F0) featuring a subtle coffee cup and Himalayan mountain silhouette, with clear, accurate text reading "THE DAILY GRIND" (avoid tiny dates that distort).

2\. Structured Website Copy (docs/site-copy.json): Return a single valid JSON object (no extra prose) containing: "hero_headline" (max 8 words), "hero_subtext" (max 20 words mentioning Bidholi students, coffee, and Pahadi food), "about_us_story" (2 concise, grounded paragraphs combining student study culture, craft coffee, and authentic Uttarakhand Pahadi comfort food—no generic corporate buzzwords), and "synthetic_personas" (an array of 3 anonymized Bidholi student/faculty personas using strict IDs "SYNTH_STU_01", "SYNTH_STU_02", and "SYNTH_STU_03" with zero real personal data).
